title: Science produces more than success.
subtitle: Make the hidden evidence useful.
text: Hello everyone. We are Laplace Flower Shop. A failed synthesis or fading battery can contain useful evidence, yet too often it stays inside one laboratory.

title: SciExchange
subtitle: Scientific evidence, exchanged with consent.
text: SciExchange brings scientific screening, provenance, reciprocal exchange, and human consent into one workspace, helping useful evidence move while preserving its context.

title: From evidence to authorized exchange.
subtitle: Screen → Trace → Agree → Authorize → Analyze
text: The workflow connects numerical checks, attestations, matching, and analysis. A React interface communicates with a FastAPI gateway, transaction store, and independent signature verification.

title: Explicit checks. Explicit limits.
subtitle: Lean-inspired diagnostics / Numerical implementation
text: Inspired by machine checkable mathematics, our compiler performs numerical screening, not a completed Lean proof. Passing checks does not establish experimental authenticity.

title: Inside the scientific workspace
subtitle: Actual application recording · Demo mode
text: Here is the actual application in demo mode. These deterministic simulated datasets cover catalytic kinetics, battery cycling, and a flagged submission. Watch the real workflow.

title: Catch the inconsistency before exchange.
subtitle: Synthetic adversarial fixture · 108.2% reported efficiency
text: First, compile the flagged submission. Its reported Faradaic efficiency exceeds one hundred percent. The interface shows rejection, physical diagnostics, and a quarantined prompt injection warning.

title: Inspect the evidence behind the record.
subtitle: Content / Laboratory / Attestation / Priority
text: Now compile the eligible catalysis benchmark and inspect its attestation. Provenance connects the source laboratory, slice, check results, and priority record. Demo records remain labeled.

title: Data for data.
subtitle: Complementary research / One agreement
text: Two laboratories offer complementary datasets. We propose a reciprocal exchange, then review exactly what each laboratory contributes and receives under the agreement.

title: One approval is not enough.
subtitle: PI A approved / PI B pending / Release locked
text: The first investigator approves. Data remains locked. One laboratory cannot authorize both sides; a proposed collaboration is not yet an authorized exchange.

title: Independent consent, on both sides.
subtitle: Simulated bilateral settlement
text: The second investigator approves; the demo reports simulated settlement. In live use, the gateway verifies both local signatures before issuing reciprocal access grants.

title: Catalysis, with units and conditions.
subtitle: LSV / Tafel kinetics / Simulated benchmark
text: The catalysis view shows polarization and Tafel kinetics. This simulated benchmark reports forty two point five millivolts per decade, with units and experimental conditions visible.

title: Battery behavior across cycles.
subtitle: Capacity retention / Differential capacity
text: Battery cycling reveals capacity retention and differential capacity. Adjusting the range helps inspect changing features, without treating a curve as proof of a degradation mechanism.

title: Context is part of the evidence.
subtitle: Temperature and electrolyte can confound comparisons.
text: The causal warning matters. Alkaline catalysis and nonaqueous batteries have different conditions. Similar patterns do not establish shared causes; comparisons require calibration and context.

title: Negative results. Positive research value.
subtitle: Eligible failure data → Internal research credit
text: The vault gives eligible negative results another route into circulation. Depositing failure data earns simulated SciCredit: internal data access credit, not cash.

title: Access is an explicit transaction.
subtitle: Challenge → Review → Acquire → Download
text: In the marketplace, request access before receiving data. Review the payment challenge, complete the simulated purchase, then download the fixture. Authorization and delivery remain distinct.

title: Open evidence. Human agency.
subtitle: SciExchange · Team Laplace Flower Shop
text: SciExchange: open evidence, human agency. Built by Zongmin Zhang, Alan Cheung, and Shaokang Li. Explore our Apache licensed repository. Thank you for listening.
